name: Vase (Meiping) with Waves
material: glazed stoneware with slip painted decoration, Jizhou ware
dimensions: Diameter: 16.7 cm (6 9/16 in.); Overall: 26.3 cm (10 3/8 in.)
summary: Jizhou ware kilns in central Jiangxi province produced a dark ware in competition with other kilns in China and so Jizhou potters were highly inventive.
